summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas but needs targeted marker and axis-design cleanup before it is publishable as-is.

issues.description: The acinar module is plausible but omits canonical pancreatic acinar amylase markers, while REG1A/REG1B are more injury/regeneration-associated than ideal core acinar discriminators.
issues.suggested_fix: Add or substitute canonical acinar markers such as AMY2A, AMY2B, CELA3A, and/or CELA3B while retaining strong existing digestive-enzyme markers.

issues.description: TFF3 is not a canonical lymphatic endothelial marker and is better known as an epithelial/secretory marker.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace TFF3 with a more plausible lymphatic endothelial marker such as NRP2, FOXC2, SOX18, MAF, or ACKR4.

issues.description: The axis gates on endothelial cells but subtracts pericyte/smooth muscle, which is not the biological sibling population for lymphatic endothelial cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Either make this a state-scoped gated axis without negatives, or add a blood/vascular endothelial sibling module and use that as the negative module.

issues.description: The contractile stellate/myofibroblast axis subtracts endothelial cells, which is not the relevant sibling state for activated stellate/fibroblast biology.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the endothelial negative and treat the contractile program as a gated state, or add a quiescent stellate/fibroblast sibling module for the negative side.

issues.description: The axis name implies a contrast against endothelium, but the implementation is a plain pericyte/smooth muscle axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename it to pericyte_smooth_muscle, or convert it to an actual contrast axis against endothelial if mural-vs-endothelial is intended.

issues.description: The combined T/NK and B/plasma axes are redundant with the separate T, NK, B, and plasma cell axes, and their negative sets mix coarse modules with fine sibling modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Prefer deleting the combined coarse immune modules/axes, or rework the immune section into a coherent two-level tree with parent lymphoid/B-lineage axes followed by gated fine subtypes.

out_of_scope: Citation DOI verification was not assessed, per the discriminator scope.
